init_distributed_mode: init a PyTorch distributed process group using environment variables for rank and world size
save_result: save results from all distributed ranks to a single JSON file in a directory
add_weight_decay: add weight decay parameter groups to a PyTorch model separating bias and weight parameters
setup_for_distributed: setup distributed printing to only output from the master process in a multi-GPU run
get_world_size: get the world size of the current distributed process group or return 1 if not initialized
